verdict.rationale: Phaser is a 2D-first framework. Its docs cover sprite game objects, sprite sheets, texture atlases and frame-based animation, and its built-in Arcade physics handles velocity, acceleration and gravity. Community users independently call it the best fit for 2D games built on "sprites, tilemaps, physics." Missing for 10: first-party docs on the core tilemap API (tilemaps appear only as a paid editor feature and in community comments), and evidence of physics beyond the lightweight Arcade system, which handles only rectangles and circles.
